store.summary: FT8, JS8 and WSPR for QRP radios, with rig control and GPS time
store.description: A weak-signal digital-mode station in your pocket. FT8 with automatic QSO sequencing and ADIF logging; a native JS8 implementation that interoperates with JS8Call (all speeds, directed messages, free text, optional auto-replies); WSPR beacon and receive with wsprnet upload when online. Controls QRP Labs QMX/QMX+, Xiegu G90/X6100/X6200 and Yaesu FT-891 through Hamlib (USB or Digirig), takes UTC and your grid from the LoRa/GPS Cap, and switches to a large layout on an HDMI monitor. Retro-synth look, keyboard driven. Requires an amateur radio licence to transmit. Hold ESC to exit.
